# Integrum Energy Infrastructure Ltd.

> Integrum Energy builds wind + solar hybrid power plants for India's industrial and
> commercial businesses, then operates them for 25 years and proves output on a live
> platform. Registered in Bengaluru, Karnataka; projects across Karnataka, Maharashtra,
> Gujarat and Tamil Nadu.

## What the company does
- Wind + solar hybrid generation under open access and group captive structures
- Behind-the-meter solar and battery energy storage (BESS)
- Energy-as-a-Service (EaaS), CAPEX and OPEX commercial models
- Lifecycle energy management: development, engineering, execution, O&M, forecasting,
  scheduling and power-market participation
- Energy Intelligence platform for live generation, consumption and settlement data

## Outcomes customers ask about
- Industrial power cost reduced toward approximately Rs 3 per unit
- Path to 100% renewable electricity (RE 100) for manufacturing loads
- 264+ MW commissioned, 155+ MW hybrid capacity, 34+ industrial partners
- Feasibility to commissioning in 4-14 months

## The SPARK framework
Scan & Develop, Plan & Design, Acquire & Build, Run & Operate, Keep Optimising —
Integrum's five-stage lifecycle partnership model.
